items.html: And therefore the Temple was destroyed in the fifth millennium, which is opposite Hod; and as we wrote in the matter of “the lie has no legs,” which is the shell, which has a hold not in the two legs but only in the left leg of Hod, which is the long leg of the monkey, and it is the left. And she herself is the Hey of Hod, which became a long Kof [monkey]. Therefore, from her and below was not clarified, for there are in them many shells.
